max_char_chunk_per_sentence.description: The maximum number of characters per chunk when combining the words into sentences. - based on ChatGPT eval 20-130 chars

max_char_chunk.description: The maximum number of characters per chunk when combining sentences into chunks.

openai_model.description: The OpenAI model to be used.

window_size_for_timesync.description: The window size for time synchronization.

delay_between_words_for_new_sentence_chu.description: Delay between words for new sentence chunk.

time_delta_max_for_timesync.description: Maximum time delta for time synchronization.

deepl_delay.description: Delay between requests to Deepl API.

translation_provider.description: Translation provider to use. Options: 'deepl' or 'openai'.

tts_api.description: Options: 'elevenlabs', 'openai', 'vibevoice'. TTS API to be used.

vibevoice_model.description: VibeVoice checkpoint or OpenAI alias used when tts_api is vibevoice.

vibevoice_cfg_scale.description: Optional VibeVoice guidance scale 1.0-3.0; empty uses the server default.

vibevoice_speed.description: Optional VibeVoice playback speed 0.25-4.0, pitch preserving.

stt_provider.description: Speech-to-text provider. Options: 'openai' (Whisper API) or 'local-whisper' (runs Whisper in the worker).

stt_chunk_length_sec.description: Length in seconds of the chunks audio is split into when it exceeds stt_max_upload_size_mb.

stt_silence_split.description: Split audio on silence between speech [true] instead of fixed stt_chunk_length_sec pieces [false].

stt_silence_sec.description: How long silence between speech must be to count as a split point for stt_silence_split.

stt_max_upload_size_mb.description: Max size in MB a provider accepts in one request; larger audio is split into chunks.

stt_local_model.description: Model used by the local-whisper provider when the project does not set stt_model.

whisper_chunk_length_sec.description: Deprecated, use stt_chunk_length_sec. Length in seconds of chunks which we split audio for processing by whisper api.

whisper_silence_split.description: Deprecated, use stt_silence_split. Should aduio be splitted by silence between speech [true] or just by whisper_chunk_length_sec [false].

whisper_silence_sec.description: Deprecated, use stt_silence_sec. How long should be silence between speech to be considered for split for whisper chunks.

whisper_api.description: Deprecated, use stt_provider. Kept so projects created before the provider boundary still resolve to a provider. Use whisper API. If false, use whisper locally.

speaker_recognition.description: Run local pyannote diarization and assign speaker labels to transcript words.

number_of_speakers.description: Expected number of speakers for pyannote diarization.

whisper_default_model_local.description: Deprecated, use stt_local_model. The model which will be used for whisper locally if not provided by the user.

whisper_api_max_size_mp3.description: Deprecated, use stt_max_upload_size_mb. Max size in MB of audio file for whisper API.

number_of_issues_to_find.description: How many issues we need to find in translation for autogenerated custom instructions pd-035-customize.py

improve_openai_model.description: OpenAI model to be used in improve stage.

use_subtitles_as_is.description: Use subtitles as is. If true, subtitles will not be converted to chunks.

openai_model_tts.description: OpenAI model to be used for TTS.

improve_output_tokens_max.description: Max tokens for model which is used to in improve stage.

improve_tokens_to_use_for_input_fraction.description: Fraction of tokens to use for input for model which is used to in improve stage.

improve_openai_temperature.description: Temperature for model which is used to in improve stage.

max_video_file_size_mb.description: Max size in MB of video file for postprocessing. If the file is larger, a preview version will be created.
